text:
sasha: Heads up — release/rc-2026.03 CI is red. The linux-gpu-integration job has been stuck ~40m on the 'run-inference-tests' step (hang in start_server). Last green on the branch: 2f9a1c4. Can someone help bisect? Job: https://ci.internal/runs/12345 :eyes:

jon: I'll take this. I can repro the hang locally in a container, hangs at `start_server` where the test waits on the gRPC stream to open.

sasha: Thanks @jon. Failing test is `tests/integration/test_streaming.py::test_prefix_cache`. Relevant log snippet from the job:
```
INFO  start_server: binding to port 50051
INFO  client: connecting to grpc://127.0.0.1:50051
WARN  grpc: stream open timed out after 30s
ERROR pytest: FatalError: test timed out waiting for stream
```

jon: Starting a bisect now on release/rc-2026.03. Using good=2f9a1c4 and bad=HEAD. Command: `git bisect start HEAD 2f9a1c4 && git bisect run ./ci/bisect-runner.sh -- tests/integration/test_streaming.py::test_prefix_cache` — will report back.

jon: Quick update — bisect completed. First bad commit: 7a3b9ff (commit message: "deps: bump grpc to 1.49.0"). Reproduces locally 100%.

maya: Nice find, thanks @jon. Can we revert that bump on the release branch to get CI green while we investigate grpc behavior? Please open a revert PR targeting release/rc-2026.03.

kai: Also please hold any merges to release/rc-2026.03 until the revert lands and we confirm the integration job. I'll add a blockade on the branch.

ci-bot: Revert PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/repo/pulls/7412 - "revert: deps: bump grpc to 1.49.0" -- CI will run against the revert.

sasha: Thanks all. Once the revert PR merges I'll re-run the failing job and mark the release green or follow up if the hang persists. If anyone wants to dig into grpc changes, ping me and I'll share the local repro steps. :thumbsup:
